observation.command: cd /workspace && for u in /en/community/openculturas-association /en/magazine/hello-world /en/about-openculturas /en/categories /en/user/1 /en/profile /en/profiles; do code=$(curl -sL -o /tmp/p.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://openculturas.ddev.site$u"); t=$(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p.html | head -1); echo "$u -> $code $t"; done
